title: First absolute Gaussian moment
statement:
For a real variable $y$ integrated against the standard Gaussian probability measure $\gamma$ on $\mathbb R$, its first absolute moment is
\[
\int_{\mathbb R}|y|\,d\gamma(y)=2\varphi(0),
\]
where $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density.
replaced: For a random variable $Y\sim N(0,1)$ and the standard Gaussian density $\varphi$, $\mathbb E|Y|=2\varphi(0)$.
